row.title: Evidence branch must be appended, never force-pushed
row.body: launch force-pushed main+1 pass to loop-evidence, deleting earlier passes' ledger rows, so closing-probe streaks never reached 2 and the queue closed nothing; fleet's queue verdicts were never committed. ledger.publish appends onto the branch tip without force; fleet lands docs/issues verdicts via push_main.
